en.title: **Security Researcher (Bug Bounty)**
en.text: Conducted vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs; confirmed and reported OWASP Top 10 flaws (XSS, SQLi, IDOR, CSRF, SSRF) with reproducible PoCs and CVSS scoring. Researched cloud misconfigurations (AWS S3, IAM) and API abuse cases (JWT tampering, weak rate limiting), documenting mitigations and hardening controls. Developed automation scripts for subdomain discovery, wordlist expansion, and nuclei scanning, reducing manual recon time from hours to minutes.

en.title: **Security Engineer Intern**
en.text: Supported SOC operations by triaging SIEM alerts, analyzing network logs, and escalating incidents per NIST IR standards. Automated SAST/DAST scans with Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP; integrated results into CI/CD pipelines to advance secure SDLC adoption. Conducted vulnerability assessments of internal web applications, identifying misconfigurations and injection flaws, and collaborated with developers to validate fixes.

en.title: **IT Systems Analyst**
en.text: Managed IT for a chain of gas stations (POS systems, Windows/Office 365, networking), ensuring stable operations and security. Applied security patches, hardened access permissions, and improved IAM policies to reduce unauthorized access risks. Resolved outages and reduced POS transaction failures by approximately 30% through proactive monitoring and preventive maintenance.
